Definition: from a derivative of the base of G1416; moaning, i.e. lamentation:--mourning.
BiblicalUsage: Odyrmos is mourning, lamentation, the wailing of grief. In Matthew 2:18 Rachel weeps for her children and will not be comforted, and in 2 Corinthians 7:7 Paul is comforted when Titus tells him of the Corinthians' mourning and their fervent mind toward him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe mourning can be refused comfort and still be met by God, and Paul's joy proves that godly sorrow ends in comfort.
